title: Went back and compared an older build of my game to where it is now, am I doing too much?
author: Afterlight_Games
selftext:
I care a lot about the environment and atmosphere so I’ve spent a bunch of time reworking the hub and arena to make them feel like places with an actual vibe and atmosphere

I’ve also been doing a pretty big visual feedback/UI pass. The video has before and afters of the Scholar and skill panel, weapon mastery, Blacksmith UI, opening chests, card selection, and a few other things

A lot of what I enjoy about working on the game is taking mechanics I already like and then going back over them to make them feel better visually and make the feedback clearer

I’ve been using Claude pretty heavily for coding, iteration, and as a second set of eyes while I work through changes, but most of the process is basically me playing the game, noticing something that feels flat or unclear, changing it, testing it again, and repeating that over and over

There’s still a ton I want to add and improve, but it’s cool seeing how much all of these smaller passes add up when you put the old and new versions next to each other. For reference, this is a two week difference

I’m pretty happy with most of the changes but I’m still unsure about the Arena and Hub. Do those feel like improvements to you or am I doing too much with them?

If anyone’s interested in checking out the project, here’s the [Steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5310380/Hollowfall/)!

comments.author: ReindeerOk2009
comments.body: Looks great to me. Using some type of tape renderer for the before and afters? I’m doing the same :)
